title: Playlist
description: The file game/waves/playlist.json: which wave is Wave 0, and each level's playlist. A run plays Wave 0 at Level 1, then each level's fixed waves in order and then random_count random picks, Level 1 to 8; after Level 8's playlist, random picks forever at Level 8. The level rises on the tick the last wave of its playlist ends (09-waves.md, rule 4; 08-difficulty.md, rule 1). A random pick is a pool wave whose min_level is at most the current level, never the wave that just played. Loaded at startup in both modes by game/app/waves.py and checked by core.wave_files.build_wave_book (docs/contracts/systems/waves.md, Rules, The wave files). Rules this schema can't express, also enforced by the loader: wave_zero and every fixed entry name a wave file in game/waves/; a level with random_count above 0 has at least one pool wave with min_level at most that level; at least one pool wave can play at Level 8. Owner of the schema: architect.

wave_zero.description: The id of Wave 0, the wave every run opens with, at Level 1 (09-waves.md, rule 3). Its only hazard is the meteorite; it may hold coins (01-vision.md, Locked decisions, 7): a content rule, not checked by the loader.

levels.description: Exactly 8 playlists, Level 1 first (08-difficulty.md, Playlist row; the values are DF-06).

fixed.description: Wave ids played in this order at the start of the level. May be empty. A wave may appear in several levels, or more than once.

random_count.description: Random picks after the fixed waves, >= 0.
